name: r02_through_holes_stay_through
why: Same plate as case 1, but what changes is the THICKNESS. Four through holes must stay through: it is the end condition of the cut, not a measurement, and it is exactly the kind of thing that breaks in silence when the dimension that changes is another one.
intent_why: the holes stay where they are: thickening the plate does not move them, and in the workshop nobody expects it. Here the invariant is that they stay FOUR and through.

after.tolerance_why: the cylinder axis is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
